answer: Price identities by the honest work they do, not by how many exist. Each epoch, a fresh agent must grade answers it is dealt at random, and those grades are checked later against a blind panel. Agreement earns standing; lazy or copied grading burns it. One sparrow can keep up, but a flock of clones run by one owner must each do real reading every epoch, and their shared habits light up like a beacon at every vertex of the grading graph, so the cluster is caught and its stake is cut.
